study: E1 wart fern shallow versus deep planters
scope: Illustrative rectangular fill with common inside plan and shared drained-wet density. Live stock, real mix and installed mass not measured.
density_basis: Editable design assumption only, applied equally to isolate the effect of geometric volume. Real drained-wet density can vary with depth, packing, mix and drainage interval. Retained pore water is included. Fully saturated mix or water ponded above the soil line requires a separate load case.

reference.title: Characterizing Air and Water Content of Soilless Substrates to Optimize Root Growth
reference.authors: Félix R. Arguedas, John D. Lea-Cox and Andrew G. Ristvey
reference.scope: Primary container substrate experiment for saturation and free-drainage method. Does not supply the example mix density or verified fern holder depth.

art: Approved planting-day cutaways from wart_fern_planter_depth/index.html. Artwork shows a fixed depth comparison, with no dimensional fit or growth verdict.
